notes: No Pet Care category exists on vaaree.com. Access: direct fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome) worked throughout, no WAF/challenge, consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass notes. Absence proof: fetched sitemap.xml -> 2 collection sitemaps (sitemap_collections_1.xml, sitemap_collections_2.xml) covering the site's full collection list (3,208 distinct /collections/<handle> URLs total). Searched this complete list for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten/animal/kennel/leash/collar/litter/scratch/feeder/bird terms. Zero collections named for dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, or generic 'pet' products (no pet beds, bowls, feeders, carriers, crates, leashes, collars, litter, grooming, or toys for household pets). Also checked the homepage HTML for any pet/dog/cat/puppy nav links - none found (site nav is Rugs & Carpets / Lighting / Decor / Kitchen & Dining / Furniture / Textiles focused, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's category list). Three superficially pet-adjacent hits were individually verified and excluded as out of scope: (1) 'pet-friendly-live-plants' - a live-plants collection curated for being non-toxic to pets, i.e. plants, not pet products (belongs to Plants & Seeds, already excluded in the prior pass). (2) 'animal-birds-accents' (502 products, title 'Buy Animal & Bird Figurines Online') - decorative animal/bird figurines, i.e. pet-themed decor objects, not products made for pet use - excluded per 'Pet-themed != Pet Care'. (3) 'bird-feeder' (11 products) - sampled product handles (ashni-bird-feeder, chidiya-love-bird-feeder-red/yellow, terracotta bird-feeders/bird-house, a bird-motif key holder) show these are decorative terracotta/garden bird feeders and bird houses for wild/garden birds, grouped with the site's garden-decor line, not supplies for a kept/domesticated pet - excluded as garden decor, not household Pet Care. Predictive search endpoint (/search/suggest.json) returned 404 (site is a headless Next.js storefront with no exposed default Shopify search API, consistent with prior pass's finding that /collections/<handle>/products.json is also unavailable), so the collections-sitemap enumeration was used as the absence-proof method instead of site search. No Pet Care rows to emit.
